# Use the Azure DevOps pipeline templates
resources:
  repositories:
    - repository: 'pipelines'
      type: 'git'
      name: 'Azure/template-pipelines'

trigger:
  batch: true
  branches:
    include:
      - develop
      - master
      - main

jobs:
  - template: jobs/sonar-process.yml@pipelines
    parameters:
      agent_pool: ubuntu-2204-vmss-mesx
      prepare_scanner_mode: CLI
      prepare_sonarExclusions: $(Build.SourcesDirectory)/node_modules/**
      prepare_sonarAdditionalProperties: |
        sonar.sources=$(Build.SourcesDirectory)/src
        sonar.test.inclusions=**/*.spec.ts
        sonar.tests=$(Build.SourcesDirectory)/src
        sonar.typescript.tsconfigPath=$(Build.SourcesDirectory)/tsconfig.lint.json

      step_postPrepare:
        - template: steps/angular-lint-and-test.yaml@pipelines
          parameters:
            nodejs_version: 22.x
            run_unit_tests: false

        - template: steps/sonarqube-reports.yml@pipelines
          parameters:
            reports:
              - name: sonar.junit.reportPaths
                path: $(Build.SourcesDirectory)/coverage/junit-tests.xml
              - name: sonar.eslint.reportPaths
                path: $(Build.SourcesDirectory)/report.json
              - name: sonar.testExecutionReportPaths
                path: $(Build.SourcesDirectory)/coverage/sonar-tests.xml
              - name: sonar.flex.cobertura.reportPaths
                path: $(Build.SourcesDirectory)/coverage/cobertura-coverage.xml
              - name: sonar.javascript.lcov.reportPaths
                path: $(Build.SourcesDirectory)/coverage/lcov.info
              - name: sonar.css.stylelint.reportPaths
                path: $(Build.SourcesDirectory)/stylelint.json
# @mesx/common-lib

resources:
  repositories:
  - repository: mesx-ops-pipelines
    type: git
    name: MES_X.0/mesx-ops-pipelines

parameters:
- name: force_publish
  displayName: 'Force publish of the npm package when branch is not "main"'
  type: boolean
  default: false

trigger:
  branches:
    include:
    - main
    - ci/*
  paths:
    exclude:
    - README.md

jobs:
- template: test/jobs/jobs-node-static-tests.yml@mesx-ops-pipelines
  parameters:
    folder: $(System.DefaultWorkingDirectory)
    auditLevel: 'critical'

- template: test/jobs/jobs-node-dynamic-tests.yml@mesx-ops-pipelines
  parameters:
    folder: $(System.DefaultWorkingDirectory)

- job: 'publish_npm_package'
  displayName: 'Build & Publish'
  pool: ubuntu-2204-vmss-mesx
  steps:
  - task: npmAuthenticate@0
    inputs:
      workingFile: .npmrc
    displayName: Authenticate Private npm Registry

  - script: |
      npm install -D
    displayName: Install npm Dependencies

  - script: |
      npm run build
    displayName: Build Library

  - script: |
      npm publish
    displayName: Publish npm Package
    condition: ${{ or(eq(parameters.force_publish, true), eq(variables['Build.SourceBranch'], 'refs/heads/main')) }}

variables:
  packageName: '@mesx/common-lib'
  org: 'https://dev.azure.com/faurecia-cloud/'
  project: 'MES_X.0'

pool: ubuntu-2204-vmss-mesx

jobs:

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Stage 1: Resolve version (single job, runs first)
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
- job: resolve_version
  displayName: 'Resolve Target Version'
  steps:
  - task: npmAuthenticate@0
    inputs:
      workingFile: .npmrc
    displayName: Authenticate npm Registry

  - script: |
      set -euo pipefail

      REQUESTED="${{ parameters.version }}"

      if [ -z "$REQUESTED" ] || [ "$REQUESTED" = "latest" ]; then
        echo "Resolving latest version from registry..."
        for i in 1 2 3 4 5; do
          VERSION=$(npm view "$(packageName)" version 2>/dev/null || echo "")
          [ -n "$VERSION" ] && break
          echo "  Retry $i..."
          sleep 10
        done
      else
        VERSION="$REQUESTED"
      fi

      if [ -z "$VERSION" ]; then
        echo "##vso[task.logissue type=error]Could not resolve version"
        exit 1
      fi

      echo "Target version: $VERSION"
      echo "##vso[task.setvariable variable=targetVersion;isOutput=true]$VERSION"
    name: version_step
    displayName: Resolve Version

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Stage 2: One parallel job per selected repo
# When "all" is checked every repo runs; otherwise only individually checked ones.
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
- ${{ each pair in parameters }}:
  - ${{ if and(ne(pair.key, 'version'), ne(pair.key, 'all'), or(eq(parameters.all, true), eq(pair.value, true))) }}:
    - job: update_${{ pair.key }}
      displayName: "Update ${{ replace(pair.key, '_', '-') }}"
      dependsOn: resolve_version
      timeoutInMinutes: 15
      variables:
        targetVersion: $[ dependencies.resolve_version.outputs['version_step.targetVersion'] ]
      steps:
      # Use built-in checkout instead of manual git clone.
      # This respects resources.repositories declarations and works
      # within job authorization scope restrictions.
      - checkout: ${{ replace(pair.key, '_', '-') }}
        persistCredentials: true

      - script: |
          echo '@mesx:registry=https://pkgs.dev.azure.com/faurecia-cloud/MES_X.0/_packaging/mesx-artifacts/npm/registry/' > $(Build.SourcesDirectory)/.npmrc
          echo 'always-auth=true' >> $(Build.SourcesDirectory)/.npmrc
        displayName: Create .npmrc

      - task: npmAuthenticate@0
        inputs:
          workingFile: $(Build.SourcesDirectory)/.npmrc
        displayName: Authenticate npm Registry

      - task: PowerShell@2
        displayName: 'Update & PR'
        inputs:
          targetType: inline
          workingDirectory: $(Build.SourcesDirectory)
          script: |
            $ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"

            # ── Helper: run a native command and fail on non-zero exit ─
            function Invoke-Native {
              param([string]$Cmd)
              Invoke-Expression $Cmd
              if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
                throw "Command failed (exit $LASTEXITCODE): $Cmd"
              }
            }

            $repo        = "${{ replace(pair.key, '_', '-') }}"
            $orgUrl      = "$(org)"
            $project     = "$(project)"
            $packageName = "$(packageName)"
            $version     = "$(targetVersion)"

            $headers = @{
              "Content-Type"  = "application/json"
              "Authorization" = "Bearer $env:SYSTEM_ACCESSTOKEN"
            }

            $branchPrefix = "deps/common-lib-update"

            Write-Host "========================================"
            Write-Host " Processing: $repo"
            Write-Host " Target version: $version"
            Write-Host "========================================"

            # ── Check current version ──────────────────────────────
            $currentRaw = (node -p "
              const pkg = require('./package.json');
              const deps = { ...pkg.dependencies, ...pkg.devDependencies };
              deps['$packageName'] || 'not-found';
            ").Trim()
            if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "node failed reading package.json" }
            $current = $currentRaw -replace '[\^~>=<]', ''

            Write-Host "  Current: $current -> Target: $version"

            if ($current -eq $version) {
              Write-Host "##vso[task.logissue type=warning]Already up to date — skipping"
              Write-Host "##vso[task.complete result=SucceededWithIssues;]"
              exit 0
            }

            if ($current -eq "not-found") {
              Write-Host "##vso[task.logissue type=warning]Package not found in dependencies — skipping"
              Write-Host "##vso[task.complete result=SucceededWithIssues;]"
              exit 0
            }

            # ── Check if branch/PR already exists ──────────────────
            $branchName = "$branchPrefix/v$version"
            $branchExists = git ls-remote --heads origin $branchName 2>$null
            if ($branchExists) {
              Write-Host "##vso[task.logissue type=warning]Branch $branchName already exists — PR pending"
              Write-Host "##vso[task.complete result=SucceededWithIssues;]"
              exit 0
            }

            # ── Create branch ──────────────────────────────────────
            Invoke-Native "git config user.email 'azure-pipelines@faurecia.com'"
            Invoke-Native "git config user.name 'Azure Pipelines'"
            Invoke-Native "git checkout -b $branchName"

            # ── Update package ─────────────────────────────────────
            Write-Host "  Updating $packageName to $version..."
            Invoke-Native "npm install '${packageName}@${version}' --save --save-prefix='^' --prefer-offline"

            # ── Audit: fix critical vulnerabilities ─────────────────
            Write-Host "  Running npm audit..."
            $auditRaw = npm audit --json 2>$null
            $auditJson = $auditRaw | ConvertFrom-Json -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
            $criticalCount = 0
            $auditFixed = $false
            if ($auditJson -and $auditJson.metadata) {
              $criticalCount = [int]($auditJson.metadata.vulnerabilities.critical)
            }
            if ($criticalCount -gt 0) {
              Write-Host "  Found $criticalCount critical vulnerabilities — running npm audit fix"
              npm audit fix 2>&1 | Out-Null
              $auditFixed = $true
            } else {
              Write-Host "  No critical vulnerabilities found"
            }

            # ── Validate: build ────────────────────────────────────
            Write-Host "  Building..."
            $buildOutput = npm run build 2>&1
            if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
              Write-Host $buildOutput
              Write-Host "##vso[task.logissue type=error]Build FAILED for $repo"
              exit 1
            }

            # ── Commit & push ──────────────────────────────────────
            # persistCredentials: true on checkout configures git credential helper
            git add package.json package-lock.json 2>$null
            git add npm-shrinkwrap.json 2>$null

            # Guard: if nothing changed (caret range already satisfied), skip
            $staged = git diff --cached --name-only 2>$null
            if (-not $staged) {
              Write-Host "##vso[task.logissue type=warning]No file changes after update — skipping"
              Write-Host "##vso[task.complete result=SucceededWithIssues;]"
              exit 0
            }

            $commitMsg = "chore(deps): update $packageName to v$version"
            if ($auditFixed) {
              $commitMsg += " and audit fix critical vulnerabilities"
            }
            Invoke-Native "git commit -m '$commitMsg'"
            Invoke-Native "git push origin $branchName"

            # ── Create PR (with retry) ───────────────────────────
            $prDescription = "Automated update of ``$packageName`` from ``$current`` to ``$version``."
            if ($auditFixed) {
              $prDescription += "`n``npm audit fix`` was applied to resolve critical vulnerabilities."
            }
            $prDescription += "`nBuild validated. Review and merge when ready."

            $prBody = @{
              sourceRefName = "refs/heads/$branchName"
              targetRefName = "refs/heads/main"
              title         = "chore(deps): update $packageName to v$version"
              description   = $prDescription
              labels        = @(@{ name = "dependencies" }, @{ name = "automated" })
            } | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5

            $prUri = "${orgUrl}${project}/_apis/git/repositories/${repo}/pullrequests?api-version=7.1"

            $pr = $null
            for ($attempt = 1; $attempt -le 3; $attempt++) {
              try {
                $pr = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri $prUri -Method Post -Headers $headers -Body $prBody
                break
              } catch {
                Write-Host "  PR creation attempt $attempt failed: $_"
                if ($attempt -eq 3) { throw "PR creation failed after 3 attempts" }
                Start-Sleep -Seconds (5 * $attempt)
              }
            }
            Write-Host "  PR #$($pr.pullRequestId) created successfully"

            # ── Set auto-complete on the PR ──────────────────────
            $autoCompleteBody = @{
              autoCompleteSetBy = @{ id = $pr.createdBy.id }
              completionOptions = @{
                mergeStrategy    = "squash"
                deleteSourceBranch = $true
              }
            } | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5

            $updateUri = "${orgUrl}${project}/_apis/git/repositories/${repo}/pullrequests/$($pr.pullRequestId)?api-version=7.1"
            try {
              Invoke-RestMethod -Uri $updateUri -Method Patch -Headers $headers -Body $autoCompleteBody | Out-Null
              Write-Host "  Auto-complete enabled (squash merge, delete branch)"
            } catch {
              Write-Host "##vso[task.logissue type=warning]Could not set auto-complete: $_"
            }
        env:
          SYSTEM_ACCESSTOKEN: $(System.AccessToken)

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Stage 3: Summary — logs consolidated results from all update jobs
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
- job: summary
  displayName: 'Summary'
  condition: always()
  dependsOn:
  - resolve_version
  - ${{ each pair in parameters }}:
    - ${{ if and(ne(pair.key, 'version'), ne(pair.key, 'all'), or(eq(parameters.all, true), eq(pair.value, true))) }}:
      - update_${{ pair.key }}
  variables:
    ${{ each pair in parameters }}:
      ${{ if and(ne(pair.key, 'version'), ne(pair.key, 'all'), or(eq(parameters.all, true), eq(pair.value, true))) }}:
        RESULT_${{ pair.key }}: $[ dependencies.update_${{ pair.key }}.result ]
  steps:
  - checkout: none
  - task: PowerShell@2
    displayName: 'Print Summary'
    inputs:
      targetType: inline
      script: |
        Write-Host ""
        Write-Host "╔══════════════════════════════════════════════════╗"
        Write-Host "║          common-lib Update Summary               ║"
        Write-Host "╚══════════════════════════════════════════════════╝"
        Write-Host ""

        $succeeded = 0; $failed = 0; $skipped = 0

        $resultVars = Get-ChildItem env: | Where-Object { $_.Name -like "RESULT_*" }

        foreach ($v in $resultVars) {
          $repoName = ($v.Name -replace '^RESULT_', '') -replace '_', '-'
          $result   = $v.Value

          $icon = switch ($result) {
            "Succeeded"           { $succeeded++; "✅" }
            "SucceededWithIssues" { $skipped++;   "⏭️" }
            "Failed"              { $failed++;    "❌" }
            "Canceled"            { $skipped++;   "🚫" }
            "Skipped"             { $skipped++;   "⏭️" }
            default               { $skipped++;   "❓" }
          }
          Write-Host "  $icon ${repoName}: $result"
        }

        Write-Host ""
        Write-Host "  Succeeded: $succeeded | Skipped/Warned: $skipped | Failed: $failed"
        Write-Host ""

        if ($failed -gt 0) {
          Write-Host "##vso[task.logissue type=error]$failed repo(s) failed — check logs above"
          Write-Host "##vso[task.complete result=SucceededWithIssues;]"
        }
